pattern_explanation: Some Spanish and English words share a Latin or Greek source and keep similar forms, so learners expect the same meaning. Here the match for the word meaning pregnant looks like the English word embarrassed but has a completely different meaning, while the planet and atmosphere pairs are true cognates with the same meaning.
false_friend_warning: The Spanish word for pregnant looks very similar to the English word embarrassed, so Spanish speakers often translate it wrongly; the Spanish word for current is also a false friend because English 'actual' means real, not current.
